info.title: Kojaya API
info.description: API untuk Kojaya mobile apps: Kojayaku (anggota koperasi), ESS (pegawai), dan Technician (teknisi lapangan).

Unauthenticated.description: Unauthorized - token tidak valid atau expired

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, logout, session — tanpa Sanctum token

tags.name: Member
tags.description: API untuk anggota koperasi (Kojayaku mobile). Ability: member:read, member:write

tags.name: Cooperative
tags.description: API untuk pengurus/kasir koperasi. Ability: cooperative:read, cooperative:write

tags.name: ESS
tags.description: Employee Self Service API. Ability: ess:read, ess:write, attendance:read, attendance:write

tags.name: Technician
tags.description: API untuk teknisi lapangan. Ability: work-orders:read, work-orders:write, work-orders:review

tags.name: Integration
tags.description: Webhook, push token, payment charge, health monitoring

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Laporan dan compliance. Ability: reports:read, employee-documents:read

tags.name: POS
tags.description: Point of Sale. Ability: pos:read, pos:write
